text:
Sasha B: heads up — during the canary this morning we saw a burst of callhook schema rejects that silently fell back to the degen route and caused a billing spike for a handful of users. console shows "validation:tool_schema_mismatch" but no clear route id. Anyone seen this pattern before?
Jamie: ugh. can you paste an example trace? is this the strict-canary we turned on at 08:15?
Sasha B: yes strict-canary on ~08:15 in us-west1. here's one example from the ingest logs (redacted):
```
request_id=rc-9a3f
model_variant=ollama-v2-q
validation.error=tool_schema_mismatch
fallback_route=degen-v1
route_id=null
```
Jamie: route_id null is the problem — routing telemetry should include the route that made the decision. looks like the reject happened before route attribution.
Lee: jumping in — our sampling pipeline drops route_id when validation happens in the router layer because we re-emit a new request to fallback. need to confirm if we propagate original meta.
Marco: if validation rejects in the adapter handshake step we lose the original dispatch metadata. two options: 1) attach original_route_id as header on the re-dispatched request, 2) emit a combined telemetry event before re-dispatch with both reject reason + original route. preference 2 for observability.
Taylor: +1 for combined event. otherwise console UX can't show the why/where. also billing team needs to correlate to avoid customer charge surprises.
Sasha B: agreed. also the console currently surfaces only "reject count" per model — we should show a breakdown: reject reason, fallback route, sampled example request_id. Small mock: 
```
- validation.reason: tool_schema_mismatch
- original.route: route:beta-ops
- fallback.route: degen-v1
- sample.request_id: rc-9a3f
```
Jamie: implementation note: pipeline emits validation telemetry at the validator stage, but sampling is downstream. if we add combined events we'll need a small cross-service schema (event_type=validation_handoff) and keep it low-QPS (1%) to avoid cost.
Lee: also worth adding a console affordance: when you click a validation spike, show a quick toggle to "trace sample" that pulls the combined event and the re-dispatched request. that solves UX and debugging.
Marco: one edge case — some tool adapters mutate payloads (coercion) and later validators accept it. we need to make sure the event captures pre-coercion and post-coercion shapes to debug root cause. maybe include small diffs.
Taylor: can we whiteboard the fields we'll include? minimal set: original_route_id, validation_reason, fallback_route_id, sample_request_id, pre_shape_hash, post_shape_hash. everything else optional.
Jamie: dev plan:
- add validation_handoff event in router (low qps sampling) — week 1 spike telemetry + schema
- attach original_route_id header on re-dispatch as fallback plan
- console: add "Validation" panel with reason + fallback + sample link — week 2
I'll open a PR for the telemetry schema.
Sasha B: thanks. one more ask: can we surface a denial page in the console (customer-facing) explaining why tool calls fell back and pointing to retry guidance? Billing wants a record to contest charges.
Taylor: yes, we can add a note in the route docs and link from console. ops/legal will want retention details.
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/strict-validate v2 -> us-west1 (08:12)
Jamie: ok i'll own the telemetry PR and a small migration to keep route_id when possible. Marco can you prototype the combined event shape? Lee can you sketch the console panel?
Marco: will do. prototyping today.
Lee: mockup by EOD.
Sasha B: great — thanks everyone. tagging billing and support in the ticket so they can correlate. :thumbsup:
